Gideon, your first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan. Your message at that time also says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel doesn't record the guard's activity after that. The only later mention is Mateo's 11:03 AM post that Kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. For the postmortem, you may want to confirm the guard's actions with the site directly.
